paper_title: Early probiotic supplementation with B. infantis in breastfed infants leads to persistent colonization at 1 year

pico.outcome: investigate if B. infantis colonization persisted up to 1 year postnatal and identify differences in reported health outcomes between B. infantis EVC001 supplemented and unsupplemented (UNS) infants

supplement: This study is follow-up study. Samples before the intervention are not collected.
